gui.noRuntime:
hyperbutler's window needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is not installed. It is part of Windows 11; on other systems get the Evergreen runtime from {url}

Until then, hyperbutler works from the terminal (hyperbutler start, hyperbutler status).

gui.closeImport:
An import is running. Stop it and close?

The item being copied is undone in hyperbutler; what is already imported stays, and Docker Desktop is not changed.
gui.notResponding: A hyperbutler window is already open for this state directory, but it could not be brought to the front. If none shows, end hyperbutler.exe in Task Manager and open the window again.

doctor.hcs-service.ok: The Host Compute Service is installed.
doctor.hcs-service.absent: The Host Compute Service (vmcompute) is not installed.
doctor.hcs-service.disabled: The Host Compute Service (vmcompute) is disabled.
doctor.hypervisor.off: The hypervisor is set not to start (hypervisorlaunchtype off).
doctor.hyperv-admins.ok: Your account is in Hyper-V Administrators.
doctor.hyperv-admins.no: The broker service does not run, and your account is not in Hyper-V Administrators, so Windows refuses to create the VM.
doctor.hyperv-admins.notNeeded: Your account is not in Hyper-V Administrators, and need not be: hyperbutler starts the VM through the broker service.
doctor.hcs.viaBroker: Hyper-V refuses your account itself, which hyperbutler does not need: it starts the VM through the broker service.
doctor.installer.failed: The installer's last setup step ({step}) failed: {detail}
doctor.hyperv-admins.pending: Your account is in Hyper-V Administrators, but this sign-in started before it was added, so Windows still refuses.
doctor.pipe.starting: {pipe} exists and hyperbutler is running; it may still be starting.
doctor.pipe.taken: Another program uses {pipe}, so hyperbutler cannot start.
doctor.docker-cli.none: No docker command was found on PATH.
doctor.docker-cli.oldBundled: {path} (bundled) is version {version}; hyperbutler needs {min} or later.
doctor.docker-cli.oldPath: {path} is version {version}; hyperbutler needs {min} or later.
doctor.docker-context.unmanaged: docker uses {what}. Context management is off, so starting does not switch it.
doctor.docker-context.env: docker in this shell uses {what}, not hyperbutler.
doctor.credential-helper.some#one: The {n} credential helper docker uses is installed.
doctor.credential-helper.some#other: All {n} credential helpers docker uses are installed.
doctor.other-engines.none: No other Docker engine is running.
doctor.other-engines.some: Another Docker engine is running: {list}. docker reaches whichever context is selected, and the engines share this PC's ports.
doctor.guest-disk.waiting: The VM has not reported its disk yet.
doctor.autostart.missing: The sign-in task {task} is missing; turning autostart on again creates it.
doctor.autostart.otherExe: The sign-in task {task} runs {command}, not this hyperbutler.
doctor.autostart.unwanted: The sign-in task {task} exists although autostart is off.
doctor.broker.unknown: Cannot read the state of the broker service: {detail}
doctor.broker.absent: The broker service is not installed. hyperbutler runs the VM itself, as a member of Hyper-V Administrators.
doctor.broker.absentNoAccess: The broker service is not installed, and your account cannot run the VM itself (it is not in Hyper-V Administrators), so hyperbutler cannot start.
doctor.broker.squatted: Another program holds the broker's pipe name {pipe}, so the broker service cannot start.
doctor.broker.foreground: {pipe} is served by a hyperbutler-broker you run yourself in the foreground, not by the service.
doctor.broker.stopped: The broker service is installed but stopped. Starting hyperbutler starts it.
doctor.broker.noAnswer: The broker service is running but does not answer: {detail}
doctor.broker.old: The broker service is version {version} (protocol {proto}); this hyperbutler needs protocol {min} or later.
doctor.broker.ok: The broker service is running (version {version}, protocol {proto}).
doctor.fix.vmp: In an administrator PowerShell, run dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform /all /norestart, then restart the PC.
doctor.fix.hcsDisabled: An administrator sets the Hyper-V Host Compute Service back to Manual in services.msc.
doctor.fix.hypervisor: In an administrator PowerShell, run bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype auto, then restart the PC.
doctor.fix.hcs: Check the items above, and that virtualization is on in the firmware (BIOS/UEFI).
doctor.fix.hypervAdmins: Install hyperbutler with its installer (the .msi), which sets up the broker service. Or an administrator runs net localgroup "Hyper-V Administrators" YOUR-ACCOUNT /add, then you sign out and back in.
doctor.fix.brokerInstall: Install hyperbutler with its installer (the .msi of the release): it sets up the broker service, and then no group is needed.
doctor.fix.installer: Uninstall and install hyperbutler again (a repair does not redo this step), or do the step by hand as docs/install.md describes.
doctor.fix.signIn: Sign out of Windows and sign back in (or restart): group changes apply at sign-in.
doctor.fix.pipeTaken: Close that program, or give hyperbutler another pipe with hyperbutler config set pipe.
doctor.fix.cliBundled: hyperbutler comes with one in {dir}. Add that folder to your PATH.
doctor.fix.cliInstall: Install a docker CLI (19.03 or later), or use clients\docker.exe from the hyperbutler zip.
doctor.fix.cliNewer: Put a newer docker CLI first on PATH, such as the one in the zip's clients folder.
doctor.fix.contextEnv: Remove DOCKER_HOST or DOCKER_CONTEXT from this shell, or run docker --context {name}.
doctor.fix.contextUse: Starting hyperbutler selects the {name} context, or run docker context use {name}.
doctor.fix.hostLow: Free up space on that drive: the VM pauses when it runs out. docker system prune frees space inside.
doctor.fix.guestFull: docker system prune and docker builder prune free space. Growing the data disk is not supported yet.
doctor.fix.autostart: Turn "Start when I sign in" off and on again in Settings.
doctor.fix.brokerSquatted: Find and close that program, then an administrator starts the service with sc.exe start {service}.
doctor.fix.brokerStart: An administrator starts it with sc.exe start {service}. If it stops again, the Application event log (source {service}) says why.
doctor.fix.brokerRestart: An administrator restarts it with sc.exe stop {service}, then sc.exe start {service}.
doctor.fix.brokerUpgrade: Install the hyperbutler release that matches this one. It updates the broker, which needs administrator rights once.
first.title: Hello, I'm hyperbutler, your butler
first.body: I run Docker for you in one small VM, without WSL. The first start creates the data disk, so it takes a few seconds more.
first.promise: No account needed · No usage data sent
error.title: Something went wrong
error.steps.title: What to do
error.generic.step1: Make a diagnostics file in Help, and attach it if you report the problem.
error.HB-GUI-001: The window sent a request hyperbutler did not accept. Reopening the window usually helps.
error.HB-GUI-002: Another change is still in progress. Try again when it is done.
error.HB-GUI-003: This setting is changed in a terminal with hyperbutler config set.
error.HB-GUI-004: Nothing refreshes while the window is hidden.
error.HB-ENG-001: The engine stopped while starting. The details say why.
error.HB-ENG-001.title: Sorry, the engine could not start
error.HB-ENG-001.step1: Make a diagnostics file in Help.
error.HB-ENG-001.step2: Try starting again. If it fails the same way, report it with the diagnostics file.
error.HB-ENG-002: The engine could not be stopped cleanly.
error.HB-ENG-003: The VM could not be restarted.
error.HB-ENG-004: The engine is not running. Start it first.
error.HB-ENG-005: hyperbutler is already running from another folder or in another session.
error.HB-ENG-005.title: Another hyperbutler is already running
error.HB-ENG-005.step1: Stop the other one with hyperbutler stop in a terminal.
error.HB-ENG-006: The engine is starting or stopping. Try again in a moment.
error.HB-VM-001: Windows did not let hyperbutler create the VM: the hyperbutler broker service is not running, and your account is not in the Hyper-V Administrators group.
error.HB-VM-001.title: Sorry, I couldn't create the VM
error.HB-VM-001.step1: Install hyperbutler with its installer (the .msi): it sets up the broker service, and then no group is needed.
error.HB-VM-001.step2: Or ask an administrator to add your account to Hyper-V Administrators, then sign out of Windows and sign in again.
error.HB-VM-003: Your account is in the Hyper-V Administrators group, but Windows applies a new group only when you sign in, so this sign-in does not have it yet.
error.HB-VM-003.title: Almost there: sign in again
error.HB-VM-003.step1: Sign out of Windows and sign back in (or restart the PC).
error.HB-VM-003.step2: Open hyperbutler and start again. You only need to do this once.
error.HB-VM-004: The hyperbutler broker service stopped or restarted, and the VM it ran for you stopped with it.
error.HB-VM-004.title: The broker service stopped
error.HB-VM-004.step1: Start again; Windows restarts the service on its own after a failure.
error.HB-VM-004.step2: If it keeps happening, run hyperbutler doctor in a terminal, or make a diagnostics file in Help and report it.
error.HB-VM-005: hyperbutler could not reach its broker service, which starts the VM for you.
error.HB-VM-005.title: The broker service does not answer
error.HB-VM-005.step1: Start again in a minute: after Windows starts, the service may still be starting.
error.HB-VM-005.step2: If it keeps failing, run hyperbutler doctor in a terminal. An administrator can restart the service: sc.exe stop hyperbutler-broker, then sc.exe start hyperbutler-broker.
error.HB-VM-006: The hyperbutler broker service refused to start the VM.
error.HB-VM-006.title: The broker service said no
error.HB-VM-006.step1: Copy the English original: it says why, for example a data folder the service does not accept.
error.HB-VM-006.step2: Run hyperbutler doctor in a terminal, or make a diagnostics file in Help and report it.
error.HB-VM-007: Another program uses a name of hyperbutler's broker service, so hyperbutler did not talk to it: that program could pretend to be the service.
error.HB-VM-007.title: Another program holds the broker's name
error.HB-VM-007.step1: Run hyperbutler doctor in a terminal: it names the pipe.
error.HB-VM-007.step2: Close that program, then restart the PC, or ask an administrator to restart the hyperbutler broker service.
error.HB-VM-008: The hyperbutler broker service on this PC is older than this hyperbutler.
error.HB-VM-008.title: The broker service needs an update
error.HB-VM-008.step1: Install the hyperbutler release that matches this one with its installer. It updates the service, which needs administrator rights once.
error.HB-VM-002: The VM switched itself off unexpectedly.
error.HB-VM-002.title: The VM stopped on its own
error.HB-VM-002.step1: Start again; this is often a one-off.
error.HB-VM-002.step2: If it happens again, make a diagnostics file in Help and report it.
error.HB-PIPE-001: Another program already uses the Docker pipe, often Docker Desktop.
error.HB-PIPE-001.title: Another Docker engine is in the way
error.HB-PIPE-001.step1: Quit Docker Desktop (or the other engine), or give hyperbutler its own pipe with hyperbutler config set pipe in a terminal.
error.HB-DISK-001: The data disk could not be opened or created.
error.HB-DISK-001.title: The data disk has a problem
error.HB-DISK-001.step1: Check that the drive with the data folder is connected and has free space.
error.HB-DISK-001.step2: Make a diagnostics file in Help if it keeps failing.
error.HB-API-001: The engine's Docker API did not answer.
error.HB-API-002: Docker refused the request. The details have its message.
error.HB-CFG-001: That value can't be used for this setting. The details say what it accepts.
error.HB-CFG-002: The settings could not be read or saved.
error.HB-DMN-001: This daemon.json can't be used. The details say why.
error.HB-DMN-002: dockerd could not be restarted with the new daemon.json. The previous settings stay in effect.
error.HB-DMN-003: This daemon.json contains passwords or tokens, so it is shown hidden and can only be edited in a text editor.
error.HB-DIAG-001: The diagnostics file could not be written.
import.title: Import from Docker Desktop
import.body: Bring your images and volumes over from Docker Desktop. Nothing in Docker Desktop is changed or removed.
import.loading: Looking at what Docker Desktop has…
import.nothing: There is nothing to import from Docker Desktop.
import.pick: Choose what to bring over. Items already imported are greyed out.
import.detail.image.already: Already in hyperbutler with the same id and tags.
import.detail.image.partial: Already in hyperbutler; importing adds the tags {tags}.
import.detail.image.conflict: hyperbutler has {tags} as another image. Remove or retag it there first.
import.detail.image.untagged: It has no tag. Give it one in Docker Desktop to import it.
import.detail.volume.already: Already in hyperbutler with the same content and labels.
import.detail.volume.conflict: A volume of this name in hyperbutler has different content.
import.detail.volume.labels: Same content, different labels: overwrite to replace it, in a terminal with hyperbutler import --from-desktop --overwrite-volumes.
import.detail.volume.exists: A volume of this name is already in hyperbutler; its content has not been compared yet.
import.detail.volume.driver: It uses the volume driver {driver}; only local volumes are copied.
import.detail.volume.options: A local volume with driver options (a bind mount or a network share): its data is not in Docker Desktop.
import.detail.volume.inuse: Running containers in Docker Desktop mount it: {containers}. Stop them there first.
import.detail.other: The import gave a reason in English; copy it to read it.
import.notes#one: An earlier import was interrupted. hyperbutler removes what it left before it copies anything ({n} note).
import.notes#other: An earlier import was interrupted. hyperbutler removes what it left before it copies anything ({n} notes).
import.cancelled: The import was stopped. What was already imported stays.
import.failed: The import stopped with an error
error.HB-IMP-001: Importing from Docker Desktop is not available in this version yet.
error.HB-IMP-002: The import stopped with an error. The details say why; what was already imported stays.
import.status.inuse: In use: stop it in Docker Desktop first
import.result: Imported: {imported}. Already here: {already}. Not imported: {refused}. Failed: {failed}.
import.sourceChanged#one: Docker Desktop changed during the import ({n} difference).
import.sourceChanged#other: Docker Desktop changed during the import ({n} differences).
confirm.import.title: Start the import?
confirm.import.body#one: {n} item will be copied from Docker Desktop. Nothing in Docker Desktop is changed.
confirm.import.body#other: {n} items will be copied from Docker Desktop. Nothing in Docker Desktop is changed.
confirm.daemon.save.title: Save daemon.json?
confirm.daemon.save.body: dockerd uses it the next time it restarts. The file you have now is replaced.
error.HB-GUI-005: That needs a confirmation, and this one was missing, used or out of date. Please try again.
error.HB-IMP-003: Docker Desktop is not running. Start Docker Desktop, then try again.
error.HB-IMP-004: This may not fit: there may not be enough free space in the VM or on this PC. Free some space or choose fewer items, or start anyway.
error.HB-IMP-005: Another import is running in this hyperbutler. Wait for it to finish.
error.HB-OS-001: Windows could not do that (open the folder or copy the text).
